title: codestory walkthrough
description: The written part of a walkthrough: titles and explanations keyed by statement id. Everything else (source, steps, values, facts) comes from the bundle. Combine them with: python codestory.py build walkthrough.json --bundle codestory_bundle.json

title.description: What the program is, e.g. 'Daily weather pipeline, line by line'.

subtitle.description: One sentence: what this walkthrough covers (the run, or every path).

entry.description: The command as the user would type it, without 'python', e.g. 'main.py --date 2026-10-01'.

explanations.description: Keyed by statement id from the bundle's statements (e.g. 'etl/clean.py:15'). One explanation applies to every time that statement runs. For a grouped step, key it to the group's first statement.

title.description: Sentence case, starts with a verb: 'Drop rows with missing values'.

text.description: 1–4 sentences for programmers: what it does, how, and anything non-obvious.

notes.description: Optional remarks for one specific step, keyed by step id from the bundle's plan (e.g. 's57'), for things true of that occurrence only.
